title: LCP History Request Row (LEP-0005 draft overlay)

request_id.description: The stored envelope's message.id — the reference pattern's 'token'.

lead_id.description: Publisher-supplied record handle, pinned at the projection (rule 6): anchored charset plus refusal of the §3 contact shapes — a leading 10-15 digit phone run, an all-digits/punctuation value, or an email address cannot ride a history row; hyphen-delimited digit segments (uuid-style ids) intentionally pass.

message_type.description: Stored-record classes only. 'ack' is excluded: acks are response artifacts, no table backs them (row universe, below; Deferred questions).

direction.description: From the platform's side: an inbound envelope it received, or an outbound record it sent/delivered.

status.description: Stored record status (open pass-through per §6 — the vocabulary stays open; the shape is pinned, rule 6).

price_cents.description: Minor units only (LEP-0003 units discipline); currency travels separately.

caller_phone_hash.description: Per-pair HMAC keyed to the REQUESTING credential. Absent — never blank — when the rule in the next section omits it.
